about.we_sell: Invented example. Route-planning software for companies that run their own delivery fleets.
about.ideal_customer: Invented example. Regional distributors and wholesalers, 50 to 2,000 staff, in North America, running 20+ vehicles.
sources: invented for this example; a real rubric lists where each part came from

questions.label: Runs its own fleet
questions.instructions: Does the company in `description` deliver goods to its customers with vehicles and drivers it operates itself?

criteria.true: It runs its own trucks, vans or drivers for deliveries.
criteria.false: It outsources delivery, ships by parcel carrier, or does not deliver physical goods.

questions.label: Segment
questions.instructions: Which of these best describes the business in `description`?

distributor.means: Wholesale distributor or dealer that delivers to other businesses.

field_service.means: Field service company whose technicians drive to job sites.

logistics_provider.means: Third-party logistics or courier company that delivers for others.

questions.label: Growth signal
questions.instructions: How strongly does `recent_news` suggest the company is expanding its delivery operations?
